title: Live Update 2.6.0
body:
# Live Update 2.6.0

Heads up, Raiders! Live Update 2.6.0 is rolling out now, bringing a wave of fixes and improvements detailed below. On top of that, a new Stencil set has arrived so you can customize your hard-won weapons.

With colder days and snowfall setting in, Cold Snap has returned! The team is also putting final touches on a new project, set to launch next week.

# Content and Bug Fixes

# Animation

* Fixed a problem where getting grabbed by a Tick while depositing a Fuel Cell could break your animations and stop you from breaching or firing weapons.

# Audio

* Improved the reliability of proximity chat on Steam Deck.

* Toned down the Gondola Transceiver alarm sound for Ballistic Gondola calls so it feels less harsh.

# Customization

* Fixed a bug where the Scorta Helmet's "On" toggle didn't unlock properly after reaching Wildcard II rank.

# Gameplay

* Fixed a bug causing players to turn invisible if they entered and quickly left the Gondola.

* Fixed an issue where the Road Warrior skill couldn't recycle Weapon Amplification Modules or Candleberries mid-raid.

* Fixed a bug where vaulting was also draining jump-stamina; the "Vaults on Vaults on Vaults" skill no longer consumes any stamina at all.

* Fixed an issue that could make players turn invisible during a round.

* Fixed a bug where initiating a knockout on a downed Raider could cause you to move and even clip through walls. You now stay in place throughout the knockout animation.

* Fixed a bug allowing enemies to knock out a player right after being revived with a defibrillator. Being revived now correctly blocks knockouts.

* The Hydra now directs only some of its weapons at Lure Grenades. It will continue targeting players while simultaneously firing some guns at the lure.

# Items

* When several Firework Boxes are triggered at once, instead of some fizzling without effect, their rocket launches are now delayed. This means activating more Firework Boxes together can extend the overall duration of a firework display.

* Corrected the Snap Hook's listed range to 18m, fixing the earlier incorrect figure of 20m.

* Fixed an issue where a thrown Grapple Hook's line could remain active after being downed. The hook now properly cancels mid-flight if firing is blocked or if you go down.

* Fixed a bug that launched players into the air when the Grapple Hook's cable struck an object before reaching its target.

# Map

**General**

* The Beachcombing Minor Map Condition has been removed from Riven Tides, with its mechanic expanded to every map instead.

* The Dockmaster's Detector can now locate buried items on all maps except Pendola Pass.

* On Pendola Pass, finding buried items still requires the Mountaineer's Detector.

* Fixed assorted collision problems around Pendola Pass, Spaceport, and Riven Tides.

* Fixed an issue where the Access Capacitor rack and its dropped batteries sometimes showed no interaction prompt, blocking pickup. These now respond correctly to interaction.

* Cold Snap has been added back into the Major Map Condition rotation!

**Pendola Pass**

* Fixed an issue preventing players from shooting through the railyard windows.

* Closed off a gap that let players fall behind a cliff and get trapped inside on Pendola Pass.

* Made further fixes to surfaces and collision inside the Emperor.

**Spaceport**

* Reworked lighting and atmosphere on Spaceport, improving visibility from interiors to exteriors, softening harsh contrast, deepening overall color tone, and speeding up exposure adjustment for better clarity.

**Buried City**

* Enhanced lighting and exposure on Buried City for better visibility in dark interiors and when viewing outside from indoors. Extreme contrast and cloud shadowing have been reduced, color tone is more natural, and bloom has been subtly adjusted.

**Stella Montis**

* Made further collision fixes around the Seed Vault Airshaft to stop players from glitching inside it.

# Quests

* Fixed a bug that could soft lock certain quests if the required quest item was lost.

# UI

**General**

* Fixed an issue where a brief tap could leave the Ping Wheel stuck open and block player input.

* Items can now be dropped simply by dragging them outside your inventory, instead of needing to be dragged to a specific drop zone.

* Fixed a bug where LB/RB bumpers failed to switch Inventory tabs at the Outpost. Button prompts now match correctly, and bumper navigation works as intended.

* Fixed an issue where the Repair button could stop responding when accessed from the Inspect screen for damaged weapons.

* Fixed a bug where returning to the Level tab on the End of Round screen could display your prior level instead of the one you just earned.

* Fixed an issue where the Mouse 4 and Mouse 5 thumb button icons showed swapped after rebinding keys.

* Reward weapons that come with a stencil already applied now correctly show that stencil on their icon.

* Fixed a bug where looting with a gamepad could cause the selected item to vanish if interrupted, such as by a Tick. Also fixed a case where splitting an item into the same slot could delete the entire stack.

* Fixed an issue where some Outpost furniture slots couldn't be selected from certain camera angles or when overlapping other stations. Selection boxes now align better with the actual items.

* Fixed a bug where the "skill point available" indicator could stay visible even after all Skill Points were spent.

* Adjusted several Outpost furniture slots to stop objects clipping through walls and to reduce camera problems when interacting with Scrappy nearby.

* Added the ability to track resources for Project steps from any page, including while previewing steps.

* Fixed a rare case where the Outpost couldn't be fully upgraded. It can now correctly reach Level 4.

**Reward Pass**

* The Reward Pass screen now rotates through multiple background images to showcase pass content.

**Store**

* Added a Show/Hide Tooltip prompt for gamepad users browsing bundles that include multiple color variants in the Store.

**Trials**

* Fixed a bug where the stars-earned pop-up in Trials failed to appear when beating your personal best. It now shows up as expected.

**Codex**

* Added a "Times Revived By A Stranger" stat to the Codex player stats page.

# Weapons

* Reduced the Stiletto's weight from 7 to 6.

* Fixed an issue where the crosshair sometimes failed to show that a shot was no longer blocked while strafing and aiming at an ARC.

* Fixed a bug where aiming down sights with scoped weapons could shift your aim sideways. Aim now remains aligned with the crosshair both entering and exiting ADS.

# Known Issues

* Calling a supply drop from the Deep-Space Telescope on Pendola Pass may cause it to land out of bounds.

* The key room in the Cielo Sereno Observatory can sometimes stay closed after using a key during the ARC Frigate Map Condition.

* Vaulting on an ARC Reclaimer can mistakenly push the player off.

* Players may occasionally get stuck inside the ARC Turbine as it lifts off if they're pressed up against it.

* On Dam Battlegrounds, landing on a tree near the Water Treatment Control building can leave the player stuck.

* Repeatedly pressing the Right Mouse Button right after throwing a throwable can prevent your character from drawing a weapon for a few seconds.

See you Topside.
